title: Battery CC-CV
text: Constant current constant voltage charging algorithm, 4 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Specify CellVoltage input as [Min,Max]} sets the option to specify CellVoltage input as minimum and maximum, {Cell voltage threshold (V)} sets the maximum allowable cell voltage, {Controller proportional gain} sets the proportional gain of PI controller, {Controller integral gain} sets the integral gain of PI controller, {Controller anti-windup gain} sets the anti-windup gain of PI controller and {Gain of signal-tracking feedback loop} sets the tracking coefficient of PI controller. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ChargingEnabled
ports.summary: Whether to enable battery charging boolean

params.name: Specify CellVoltage input as [Min,Max]
params.values: Option to specify CellVoltage input as minimum and maximum values off (default) | on

params.name: Controller proportional gain
params.values: Proportional gain of PI controller 100 (default) | scalar

params.values: Integral gain of PI controller 10 (default) | scalar

params.values: Anti-windup gain of PI controller 1 (default) | scalar

params.values: Tracking coefficient of PI controller 1 (default) | scalar
